claims.statement: Contre-indiquee en cas d'hypersensibilite aux Asteracees (Composees).
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Matricaria recutita L., flos (EMA/HMPC)
claims.quote: Hypersensitivity to the active substance and to other plants of the Asteraceae (Compositae) family.

claims.statement: Interactions via le CYP450 rapportees uniquement chez les transplantes renaux sous fortes doses prolongees (voie orale).
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Matricaria recutita L., flos (EMA/HMPC)
claims.quote: For patients after renal transplantation taking high dosages for longer periods (about two months) interactions based on effects on CYP450 have been reported.

claims.statement: Aucune interaction rapportee pour les voies cutanee, oromuqueuse, inhalation et bain.
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Matricaria recutita L., flos (EMA/HMPC)
claims.quote: Cutaneous, oromucosal use, inhalation, or as bath additive: None reported.

claims.statement: Pour les preparations autres que la forme a), la securite pendant la grossesse et l'allaitement n'est pas etablie.
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Matricaria recutita L., flos (EMA/HMPC)
claims.quote: Safety during pregnancy and lactation has not been establis

claims.statement: Contre-indiquee en cas d'hypersensibilite a la substance active.
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Valeriana officinalis L., radix (EMA/HMPC)

claims.statement: Aucune interaction rapportee dans la monographie EMA (usage etabli et traditionnel). Ne vaut pas absence d'interaction : voir autres sources avant d'affirmer le contraire.
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Valeriana officinalis L., radix (EMA/HMPC)

claims.statement: Securite pendant la grossesse et l'allaitement non etablie ; usage non recommande.
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Valeriana officinalis L., radix (EMA/HMPC)
claims.quote: In the absence of sufficient data, the use during pregnancy and lactation is not recommended.

claims.statement: Association contre-indiquee avec anticoagulants de type coumarine, ciclosporine, evérolimus, sirolimus, tacrolimus systemique (voir §4.5). Portee selon la dose d'hyperforine a faire confirmer par le relecteur.
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Hypericum perforatum L., herba (EMA/HMPC/7695/2021)
claims.quote: Concomitant use with coumarin-type anticoagulants, cyclosporine, everolimus, sirolimus, tacrolimus for systemic use

claims.statement: Les preparations de millepertuis induisent CYP3A4, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 et la P-glycoproteine.
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Hypericum perforatum L., herba (EMA/HMPC/7695/2021)
claims.quote: Hyperici herba preparations induce the activity of CYP3A4, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and P-glycoprotein.

claims.statement: Baisse des concentrations des contraceptifs hormonaux : saignements intermenstruels et securite contraceptive reduite ; mesures contraceptives supplementaires necessaires.
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Hypericum perforatum L., herba (EMA/HMPC/7695/2021)
claims.quote: The reduction of plasma concentrations of hormonal contraceptives may lead to increased intermenstrual bleeding and reduced safety in birth control.

claims.statement: Usage non recommande pendant la grossesse et l'allaitement (toxicite reproductive chez l'animal).
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Hypericum perforatum L., herba (EMA/HMPC/7695/2021)
claims.quote: The use is not recommended during pregnancy and lactation.

claims.statement: Usage non recommande avant 18 ans (donnees insuffisantes).
claims.source: EU herbal monograph on Hypericum perforatum L., herba (EMA/HMPC/7695/2021)
claims.quote: the use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age is not recommended.
